data.name: Admin.Setup.Intro
data.value: This account runs the server: it approves new accounts, decides who may create campaigns, and changes the server's settings. Then a few choices, each already set to a safe default.

data.name: Admin.Setup.ChangeLater
data.value: You can change this later on the admin page.

data.name: Admin.Setup.Fetch
data.value: Where may book stylesheets load fonts and pictures from?

data.name: Admin.Setup.Done.Ai
data.value: Add an AI model for the AI buttons

data.name: Admin.Setup.Done.Library
data.value: Look through the Library of game systems and content

data.name: Admin.Setup.Done.Admin
data.value: Open the admin page: accounts, settings and the log

data.name: Admin.Setup.Skip
data.value: Keep the rest as they are

data.name: Admin.Settings.NotSaved
data.value: The settings could not be saved. Try again.

data.name: Admin.Settings.SignUp.Approval
data.value: Anyone, after the admin approves them

data.name: Admin.Settings.SignUp.ApprovalHint
data.value: New accounts wait on the admin page. Someone who arrives with a campaign invite is approved at once, as a player.

data.name: Admin.Settings.SignUp.InviteOnly
data.value: Only people with a campaign invite

data.name: Admin.Settings.SignUp.InviteOnlyHint
data.value: Without an invite link from a GM, nobody can create an account.

data.name: Admin.Settings.SignUp.OpenHint
data.value: Anyone who can reach the server gets an account straight away. Fine at home, where only your own network can reach it.

data.name: Admin.Settings.SignUp.Internet
data.value: While the server is open to the internet, a new account always needs a campaign invite.

data.name: Admin.Settings.Campaigns.GameMastersHint
data.value: The admin makes an account a Game Master on the admin page. Everyone else joins campaigns as a player.

data.name: Admin.Settings.Campaigns.AnyoneHint
data.value: Every account can run its own campaigns.

data.name: Admin.Settings.Fetch
data.value: Where book stylesheets may load from

data.name: Admin.Settings.Fetch.Hint
data.value: A book's stylesheet can name fonts, pictures and other stylesheets on the web. The server fetches a copy once and keeps it with the book.

data.name: Admin.Settings.Fetch.Listed
data.value: Only from the sites on this list

data.name: Admin.Settings.Fetch.ListedHint
data.value: Font services and the picture hosts brews use. A GM who needs another site asks the admin to add it.

data.name: Admin.Settings.Fetch.AnyHint
data.value: Any https address on the internet. Never this computer or your home network.

data.name: Admin.Settings.Fetch.SitesHint
data.value: One site a line, like fonts.gstatic.com. A site also covers the names under it.

data.name: Admin.Settings.Fetch.Bad
data.value: Not a site name, left out: {0}

data.name: Admin.Waiting.Heading
data.value: Your account is waiting for approval

data.name: Admin.Waiting.Body
data.value: The server's admin approves new accounts. Once {0} is approved, you can join campaigns here.

data.name: Admin.Waiting.Later
data.value: If you have an invite link from a GM, open it: an invite approves you as a player.

data.name: Admin.Subtitle
data.value: Accounts, the server's settings, and what admins did.

data.name: Admin.Accounts.Waiting
data.value: {0, plural, one{# account is waiting for approval.} other{# accounts are waiting for approval.}}

data.name: Admin.Accounts.LastAdmin
data.value: The server needs at least one admin.

data.name: Admin.Accounts.Gone
data.value: That account has changed or is gone. The list is up to date now.

data.name: Admin.Accounts.RejectBody
data.value: The account is deleted and its name is free again. They can sign up again later.

data.name: Admin.Accounts.DisableBody
data.value: They are signed out and cannot sign in until you turn the account on again. Their campaigns and characters stay.

data.name: Admin.Accounts.InCampaigns
data.value: {0} is in a campaign. Turn the account off instead; removing someone from their campaigns comes in a later version.

data.name: Admin.Accounts.DeleteBody
data.value: The account is deleted for good and its name is free again. This cannot be undone.

data.name: Admin.Setup.ServerAi
data.value: Who may use the server's AI key?

data.name: Admin.Settings.ServerAi
data.value: Who can use the server's AI key

data.name: Admin.Settings.ServerAi.Hint
data.value: Someone with no AI model of their own uses the key in the server's configuration, if there is one, with a daily allowance each. Everyone can always add their own model.

data.name: Admin.Settings.ServerAi.GameMastersHint
data.value: Accounts the admin made Game Masters, and the admin. A player who is a co-GM in someone's campaign is not a Game Master.

data.name: Admin.Settings.ServerAi.EveryoneHint
data.value: Players too. Each account still has the daily allowance.

data.name: Admin.Settings.ServerAi.AdminsHint
data.value: Only the server's admins. Everyone else uses their own model.
